source.description: Project raw-data parse/load API that turns attacker-controlled PDF bytes into a Poppler document.
source.value_from: Attacker-controlled PDF bytes enter the Poppler document parser.; value `file_data`; from `document_private *doc = new document_private(`

sink.description: ASan container-overflow write when assigning glyph_to_cache_index[j] after only reserving capacity.

root_cause.description: The code reserves glyph_to_cache_index capacity but does not increase vector size before writing by index.

tainted_value_origin.description: The parsed page text controls the number of glyphs iterated while constructing text_box font metadata.

coarse_trace.summary: Loads attacker-controlled PDF bytes into Poppler.
Requests page text with font metadata via p->text_list(text_list_include_font).
Builds glyph-to-font cache mapping and writes beyond vector size.

fine_trace.note: Project raw-data parse/load source: the PoC bytes are parsed as a PDF document.

The runtime sanitizer stack shows the ARVO/OSS-Fuzz harness reaching poppler::page::text_list at /src/fuzz/pdf_fuzzer.cc:49. This harness file is not present in the checked-out upstream Poppler tree, so this step is runtime-observed harness context rather than public-source verified code.
The parsed PDF text content determines how many glyph entries are processed.
reserve() only allocates capacity; it leaves vector size at zero, so later operator[] writes are outside the logical container. The patch changes the write to push_back(-1).
ASan reports a container-overflow WRITE of size 4 at this indexed assignment.
